blocks.text: 跨进程 RPC。 用一套 `request` / `notify` / `stream` 调用另一个操作系统进程里的函数。它可以是你启动的子进程，也可以是已经在运行、通过本机 socket 连接的服务。本包负责启动子进程、打开 stdio 或 socket 字节通道、认证握手和监督重启；调用语义、超时、取消、错误还原等由 `@migaia/rpc-core` 统一提供。
适用：

items: 主进程把 CPU 密集、易崩溃或需要隔离权限的工作放进子进程，并像调用本地函数一样调用它。
多个本机进程之间（例如 CLI 与常驻守护进程）通过 TCP 回环或 Unix socket 互相调用。
需要由 PluginHost 统一管理一组子进程：查询状态、监听事件、重启或替换。
Node、Bun、Deno 或 Electron utility process 之间互通。

blocks.text: 不适用：

items: 同一进程内的 Worker 线程：用 `@migaia/rpc-threads`，可以零拷贝转移 `ArrayBuffer`。
浏览器内的窗口、iframe、Service Worker：用 `@migaia/rpc-browser`。
Python、Go、Rust 等非 TypeScript 对端：本包的 `createProcessPeer` 支持 `spawn.wire: 'jsonrpc'`；自有字节通道使用 `createProcessJsonRpcChannel`。
跨机器网络通信：socket 适配器只接受本机地址（`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]`、Unix socket 路径或 Windows 命名管道）。
需要严格保证"整棵进程树都被终止"：Node launcher 目前只能尽力终止（见下文）。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-process @migaia/rpc-core @migaia/rpc-contract

blocks.text: `@migaia/rpc-core` 与 `@migaia/rpc-contract` 是 peer 依赖，三者版本必须完全一致（当前 `0.0.9`）。运行时依赖 `@migaia/supervision`（进程监督与预算）、`@migaia/plugin-host`、`@migaia/utils`，会随包安装。
两个可选 peer，只在用到对应子路径时才需要：

rows: `createNodeProcessLauncher`（Node 启动子进程）、`openProcessStdioChannel`（子进程读取自己的 stdio）
`dialProcessByteChannel`、`listenProcessByteChannel`（TCP 回环 / Unix socket / 命名管道）
Bun 下的同名能力（`createBunProcessLauncher` 等）
Deno 下的启动器与 socket

sections.heading: 快速开始：启动子进程并调用它

blocks.text: 子进程只需声明自己提供的方法。它由库的 launcher 启动时，会通过 bootstrap 自动连回父进程，不需要任何地址配置。
父进程只需给出入口。URL 精确指向文件；相对字符串按主入口目录解析。`.ts` 可直接运行，但 Node 的原生类型剥离不会把 `.js` imports 改写为 `.ts`：有这种 import 的项目应传构建后的 `.js`，或保留父进程的 `--import` loader。Bun 能解析该 TS 导入写法；Deno 也需要构建输出或 loader。

sections.id: 同一份入口派生子进程
sections.heading: 同一份入口派生子进程

blocks.text: `spawn: true` 重新执行当前主入口，包含全部顶层代码。先用 `isProcessChild()` 区分角色，避免子进程再次派生。这个函数只读已有 bootstrap 标记；真正认证仍由 stdin bootstrap 和原握手完成。Node/Bun 的 runtime flags（包括 `--import`）与程序参数会保留。
REPL、`--eval`、单文件可执行程序、Electron 或测试运行器没有可用的自派生主入口时，会以注册的配置错误拒绝，不猜测调用位置。Deno 默认子入口只获得 bootstrap 所需的 env 权限；需要额外运行权限时使用显式 command/args。
需要把子进程放进外部沙箱时，短对象的 `wrap(command)` 可包装运行时计算出的启动命令，重启与替换时同样生效。库不提供沙箱工具或配置；`sandbox-exec`、`bwrap` 示例及 stdin/stdout、环境与退出码转发要求见 Running the child in an external sandbox。

名称不含 `/` 或协议。双方按 OS 用户与名称派生相同的本机端点，无需端口或通信文件。Unix 目录为 0700，socket 为 0600；当前 Node-compatible socket API 没有公开 peer-credential 读取接口，访问控制由这些 OS 权限完成。同一用户的任何进程都能连接；需要区分同用户程序时，双方显式设置 `token`。TCP、显式 socket 路径及没有 ACL 保证的 Windows named pipe 必须设置 token。
named `connect` 默认等待最多 5000 ms，可设 `connectTimeoutMs`。第二个同名 listener 仍以 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED` 拒绝；崩溃遗留 socket 只由现有 owner record 安全回收。

blocks.text: 原始 launcher、预算、bootstrap 与握手 source 仍可直接传入。下面在现有工厂中直接组合完整来源，每个来源只交给一个 Peer 或 Plugin 使用。

完整来源示例的 `report` 会收到 `@migaia/supervision` / `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`（`capability: 'termination'`）。这是预期提示：Node launcher 不能保证终止孙进程。短来源省略 `report` 时，每个 native process 至多报告一次终止能力提示。显式提供的所有 reporter（包括直接传 `defaultRpcReporter`）逐次接收，与包装同一函数的行为一致；短对象的 `onNotice` 可接管这些提示。其他错误始终正常报告，策略不再依赖函数身份。
每个 Peer 必须且只能选择一种来源。唯一例外是由库 launcher 启动的子进程：它省略来源时会自动连回父进程。

sections.heading: 两种所有权：Peer 与 Plugin

items: `createProcessPeer`：独立连接，调用方负责 `close()`。适合脚本、CLI，或只有一个子进程的场景。

`createProcessPlugin`：安装进 `@migaia/plugin-host`，由 Host 统一持有和释放。调用经 `host.process.request(target, method, …)`；`list` / `get` / `on` / `watch` / `stop` / `restart` / `replace` 也都在这个出口上。适合需要管理多个子进程、观察状态或热替换的应用。

blocks.text: Process carrier 观察尚未实现：`createProcessTransport(...).transport.observe` 当前不存在。计划中的字节事件包含 `detail.frameBytes`（含 4 字节长度前缀的完整物理帧字节数）与 `detail.drainMs`（物理写入发生回压后等待 drain 的毫秒数），内容捕获仅在 `probe.capturing` 为 true 时启用，并保留原字节引用。Node/Bun/Deno stdio 与 socket 的帧编码、解码和 transport 由 Core 的统一字节通道持有；当前接口未暴露帧观察与真实回压等待。Electron utility process 实际使用 whole-message 通道，仍需确定其 detail 语义。完成这些接口前，不应将逻辑 send 耗时当作 `drainMs`，也不能声称 Process carrier 已支持观察。
本包登记的通道、启动与监听错误带 `(source, code)`，按这两个字段判断，不要依赖 `message` 文本。同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断保留原生对象、类型及 stack，并把原生 errno code 归入本包语义码；操作系统其它字段仍保留：

items: 本包错误：`source === '@migaia/rpc/process'`，`code` 取自 `RpcProcessErrorCode`，例如 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`、`PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`。
调用层错误来自 `@migaia/rpc/core`，例如超时 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`（`TimeoutError`）、取消 `CANCELLED`（`AbortError`）、过载 `OVERLOADED`。
对端业务函数抛出的错误会还原原生类型、`message` 和 `stack`，例如子进程抛 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 超时、断线或"结果未知"都不代表对端没有执行。重试非幂等操作前请先对账，详见 USEGUIDE 第 8 节。

sections.heading: 2. 子进程端：自动连回父进程

blocks.text: 子进程入口只需要调用 `createProcessPeer`，并在 `provide` 中声明可被调用的方法：
父进程同组示例：

items: 自动来源的前提：省略 `spawn` / `connect` / `listen` 只在"本进程由库的 launcher 启动"时成立。launcher 会通过环境变量（`PROCESS_RUNTIME_API_ENV`）和 bootstrap 把父端信息交给子进程。直接用 `node service.js` 运行这个文件会在配置阶段拒绝。想让一个独立运行的服务被连接，用第 5 节的 `listen`。

`provide` 的规则：只读取对象自身的可枚举数据属性。嵌套对象生成点分路径（`math.double`），getter、循环引用、重复路径或非法名字会在建立连接前被拒绝。普通函数通过 `request` / `notify` 调用，返回值必须可移植（可被 JSON 表示的数据，或协商后的 `ArrayBuffer` / `Uint8Array`）；返回 iterable 或 async iterable 的方法通过 `stream` 调用。
反向调用：子进程得到的也是一个 Peer。父端同样可以 `provide` 方法，子进程用 `request` 调用父端。
生命周期：子进程的 Peer 会保持事件循环存活，直到父端关闭连接。

sections.heading: 3. spawn 来源：启动并拥有子进程

blocks.text: 普通 TS 子进程用 `spawn: './service.ts'` 或 `spawn: new URL('./service.js', import.meta.url)`；`spawn: true` 重跑主入口。
`isProcessChild()` 只表示本入口由既有 launcher bootstrap 启动，不授予信任。它在发现过程消费 env 标记后仍返回 `true`。子进程执行整个模块，包括顶层初始化；应把父进程启动逻辑放进 `else`。

相对字符串按主入口目录解析；显式 URL 不受当前工作目录影响。短对象可用 `{ entry: './service.ts', base: import.meta.url }` 指定基准。Node/Bun 保留 runtime flags 与 loader，移除 eval/print/test 控制参数，所以父入口的 loader 会继续生效；Node 原生类型剥离不解析 `.js` 指向 `.ts` 的 imports，Node/Deno 此类项目要构建输出或 loader，Bun 可直接解析。失败保留原监督错误及其 cause 与 stderr 诊断，不把错误改成成功。
自派生不支持 REPL、eval、Electron、测试运行器及无可用主模块的单文件可执行程序；传精确 URL 或 `{ command, args }`。Deno 默认用 `run` 与 bootstrap 的 env 权限；额外权限通过显式 command/args 提供。

短对象的 `args`、`cwd`、`env`、`stdio`、`limits`、`permissions`、`supervision` 可以覆盖默认值；`wrap` 可包装计算出的启动命令。默认每源创建一个 process budget、随机 stdin token、byte channel 与 best-effort supervisor。未配置 `report` 时复用默认控制台出口，并按进程合并预期终止能力通知；配置 `report` 后对每次启动都调用该函数，直接传默认函数与转发包装函数一视同仁。若设置短对象 `onNotice`，该 callback 收到原始通知并替代本项 reporter 调用。完整来源保持原有报告语义。

sections.heading: Running the child in an external sandbox

blocks.text: 短对象的 `wrap(command)` 接收 rpc 按当前 Node、Bun 或 Deno 运行时计算出的 `IProcessLaunchCommand`，返回新的 `command`、`args`、`cwd` 与 `env`。首次启动、每次 restart 和 replace 都调用一次；自定义 `supervision.launcher` 也经过这个回调。rpc 不导入沙箱工具，也不提供沙箱配置文件，安装与策略由应用负责。
macOS 上可用 `sandbox-exec` 加载应用自己维护的 profile。下面保留原运行时命令、参数、工作目录与环境设置；应用的 profile 必须允许子入口及其依赖所需的读取：
Linux 上可用 `bwrap`。这个例子把现有文件系统挂为只读，提供 `/proc` 与 `/dev`，并隔离网络；需要写入的应用应按自己的策略增加可写挂载：
`./service.ts` 使用第 2 节的自动来源模式，并在 `provide` 中声明 `echo`。以上都是平台示例，运行前由应用安装相应工具并准备自己的策略。
包装器必须遵守两个规则：

items: stdin/stdout 直接连到子进程。 stdin 承载 token bootstrap，随后 stdin/stdout 承载 RPC 字节通道；不要分离、消费这些流或把包装器日志写到 stdout。

完整转发子进程环境与退出码。 保留 `env.inherit` 和 `env.set`；原生 launcher 在 `wrap` 返回后才加入 `PROCESS_RUNTIME_API_ENV`（`MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP`）。容器包装器要用例如 `-e MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP` 把该变量转入容器，同时转发其余环境变量。包装器应返回子进程的原退出码，不能把非零退出改成成功；这让监督层正确区分正常退出与崩溃。

blocks.text: `wrap` 不接收 `stdio`、`bootstrap`、`limits` 或 `permissions`，返回对象中的这些额外字段会被忽略。完整 `kind: 'spawn'` 来源继续由调用方直接持有 `supervision.launcher` 与 `spec`。

非函数 `wrap` 在准备来源时拒绝。回调抛错或返回非法字段会使本次启动失败，带 `PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION` 的原生 `TypeError` 位于 supervision 的 `LAUNCH_FAILED` cause 链上；回调抛出的原值保留在该 `TypeError.cause`。经 `host.use` 安装时，最外层仍是 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`。
`spawn` 对象把四件事组合在一起：怎么启动（`supervision`）、拿哪条通道（`rawChannel`）、怎么握手（`establish`）、用什么凭据（`token`）。README 的“高阶用法”直接展示完整来源对象，下表解释每个字段。

rows: 固定值，表示对象形式的 spawn 来源。
`'byte'`（stdio / socket 字节流）或 `'message'`（Electron utility process 等消息通道）。
完整 `channelKind: 'byte'` spawn 必须显式选 `'native'` 或 `'jsonrpc'`；message spawn 必须省略 wire。只有短来源会补 native 默认值。
会话凭据。经 bootstrap 交给子进程，握手时双方用它认证。每次部署随机生成，不要打印或写入日志。
该执行单元在监督与查询中的标识。
平台 launcher。`rawChannel` 读取本次启动实际返回的 handle。
`createUnitBudget({ kind: 'process', maxUnits })`：限制同时存在的子进程数量。这是应用层计数，不是操作系统资源限制。
`'best-effort'` 或 `'required'`。`required` 要求 launcher 声明必需能力受到保证；Node 的整树终止能力不满足，只能用 `best-effort`。
启动规格：`command`、`args`、`env`（`inherit` 继承的变量名、`set` 设置的变量）、`stdio`、`bootstrap`，以及可选的 `limits`。
stdio 走通道时用 `{ stdin: 'channel', stdout: 'channel', stderr: 'drain' }`；stderr 会被持续读取并做限流诊断（第 7 节）。
`{ via: 'stdin', payload }`：启动后先把 payload（通常是 token）写给子进程，再开始协议握手。
可选，单次调用的墙钟上限。它会压低任何调用自己设置的超时。
返回 launcher 为这次启动建立的原始通道。
在原始通道上完成握手，返回协议通道。用 `createProcessTransport`，并传入 `prepared` 里的 `offer`、`scheduler` 与会话信息。

blocks.text: 还有两个可选字段：`offer` 用来手动收窄本端能力提议，一般不需要；`supervision.restart`、`health` 等监督策略见 `@migaia/supervision`。
高级回调形式：`spawn` 也可以是 `async (context) => sourceResult`，由你自己启动执行单元并返回已完成协商的通道。这种形式不经过 supervision，Peer 不会获得 stop / restart / replace 能力，一般只在自定义运行时中使用。
`createProcessPeer<TRemote>()` 返回的 Peer 提供以下方法。传入远端方法类型 `TRemote` 后，方法路径、参数和返回值都有类型检查。

rows: 只发送，不等业务结果。Promise 完成仅表示已发出，不代表对端执行成功。
惰性：第一次 `next()` 前不发送。提前 `break` / `return()` 会通知对端结束生产。
一组 request 按顺序执行；某步失败后，其余步骤为 `not-executed`。不回滚已执行步骤。
查询带 `idempotencyKey` 的调用状态：`pending`、`done`（含结果）或 `unknown`。
本端身份、已接受的连接与方法目录。本地查询，不发网络请求。
停止接受新调用，已接受的调用继续完成，然后关闭连接；spawn 来源还会停止子进程。重复调用返回同一个 Promise。

blocks.text: 示例：

rows: 截止时间。默认 30000 ms（可用工厂的 `defaultTimeoutMs` 修改）；`false` 关闭默认超时；`0` 表示立即到期。
取消。取消是协作式的：本地放弃等待，不保证对端没有开始执行。
幂等键。同键重复调用复用已保留的结果；可用 `outcome(key)` 查询。
同一 `orderKey` 的调用在对端按发送顺序串行执行。
取消时，若对端尚未开始执行则撤销；若已开始，仍等待并返回真实结果。

blocks.text: 进程间调用不支持 `transfer`（零拷贝转移只在 Worker 中可用）；传入 `transfer` 属性（哪怕是空数组）会被拒绝。`ArrayBuffer` / `Uint8Array` 作为普通数据传输时会被复制。
不传泛型时没有可调用的方法类型。需要按字符串动态调用时，用 `IRuntimeDynamicSurface`：它只放宽编译期检查，运行时仍按对端实际目录拒绝未知方法。

sections.heading: 5. 连接已运行的服务：connect 与 listen

blocks.text: 普通名称自动映射同一用户的本机端点，适合独立启动的程序。连接端先启动时，默认等最多 5000 ms；`connectTimeoutMs` 修改这个等待上限。

POSIX named endpoint 使用 0700 用户目录与 0600 socket，并复用已有 Unix owner record；第二个同名 listener 拒绝，只有相同服务的崩溃遗留 inode 可以回收。Node-compatible socket API 未提供 peer-credential 读取接口，因此访问控制来自 OS 文件权限。这个边界允许该用户的任何进程接入；显式 `token` 可以进一步限制同用户应用。TCP、显式 socket 路径及本 adapter 未提供 ACL 的 Windows named pipe 必须给 token。内部 same-user hello 标记是公开协议值，不是 secret，也不代替 OS 权限。
完整监听与连接来源如下。
当服务进程不是由你启动的（例如常驻守护进程），服务端用 `listen` 接受连接，客户端用 `connect` 连接。两端都通过握手认证：服务端的 `verify` 校验客户端提供的 `token`。
地址格式：`tcp://127.0.0.1:<port>` 或 `tcp://[::1]:<port>`（只允许回环地址），Unix socket 绝对路径（以 `/` 开头），Windows 命名管道（`\\.\pipe\name`）。端口写 `0` 时由系统分配，实际地址由 `listen` 返回。

sections.heading: 高阶：完整 socket 来源

blocks.text: 这一组在同一程序中创建服务端与客户端，实际地址从原 listener 返回，关闭时分别释放连接和 listener。独立部署时，应用将该地址与凭据交给客户端。
省略 `createNativeProcessOffer` 的 `capabilities` 时，监听端根据 Core 已安装的能力生成 runtime 提议。显式传入 `capabilities`（包括空数组）仍表示调用方选择的窄提议，库不会拓宽它。
凭据错误时：客户端的 `createProcessPeer` 以 `@migaia/rpc/remote` / `REMOTE_START_FAILED` 拒绝，服务端的 `report` 收到 `@migaia/rpc/process` / `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`。不要用同一个错误凭据重试。
要点：

items: 每个接入的客户端都是独立会话，有各自的 `peerId` 和身份。服务端可以对某个会话反向调用；会话 principal 来自 `verify` 的返回值，而不是客户端自报的字段。
`connect` 可选 `supervision`（`restart`、`startupTimeoutMs`、`health` 等）：只用于重建本端连接，不会拥有或重启对端进程。
Unix socket 监听时会写一个属主记录文件，用来识别并回收崩溃遗留的同名 socket；属于其它服务的路径会被拒绝。

blocks.text: `createProcessPlugin` 接受与 Peer 相同的来源和 `provide`，另加 `name`（Host 内的连接名）与可选的 `expose`。它返回一个插件，由 `host.use` 安装，然后经 `host.process` 出口调用：
`host.process` 出口的方法：

rows: 与 Peer 相同，第一个参数是目标：连接名，或 `{ name, instanceId }`（同名多实例时必须精确指定）
查询连接、身份、代次、健康与退出信息；拿不到的事实返回 `unavailable`，不会伪造为 0
订阅生命周期事件；`on` 返回可重复调用的取消函数，`watch` 是有界异步迭代器
对多个目标调用并汇总各自结果；不保证全部成功
只对 spawn 来源有效；对 connect / listen 来源调用会以 `CAPABILITY_CONFLICT` 拒绝

blocks.text: `expose`：默认为空，即不把本端 Host 的任何方法公开给子进程。要让子进程调用本端某个 Feature 的方法，显式列出路径，例如 `expose: ['parent.echo']`；只列出的方法可见，`expose: ['math.add']` 不会顺带公开 `math.sub`。
`replace`：用新的 spec 启动后继进程并切换流量。正在执行的调用仍在原进程中完成，不会被转移到新进程。

items: 并发上限：每个对端最多 64 个、全局最多 256 个同时执行的入站调用。超出时调用方收到 `@migaia/rpc/core` / `OVERLOADED`，对端函数不会被调用。可在工厂选项 `providerLimits` 中调整 `maxPerPeer`、`maxGlobal`，并用 `onRejected` 观察被拒绝的调用及其原因。
单帧上限：握手帧不超过 `PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES`；业务消息受协议帧上限约束，超限时以 `FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` 拒绝。大数据请分批发送，或用 `stream` 逐项传输。
stderr 限流：子进程 stderr 被持续读取，避免管道写满阻塞子进程。每个会话每 1000 ms 最多产生 32 条 `ipc.stderr` 诊断记录；超出部分合并为一条带 `droppedChunks` 计数的摘要，文本经过脱敏。
健康检查：native 协议的连接默认启用 ping 健康检查；连续失败时报告 `PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED`，由监督策略决定是否重启。`wire: 'jsonrpc'` 时默认不启用 ping。
连接治理：`createProcessResilience` 用于自定义连接数、调用速率、payload 上限，以及实例不健康时的挂起与清算策略。超限时以 `PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT` 拒绝，同样发生在对端函数执行之前。

blocks.text: 本包登记的通道、启动和监听错误使用原生 `Error`（或其子类）及 `source`、`code`。原生同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断在原对象上附包身份，原生 errno code 改为语义码，类型、其它字段和 stack 保持；已有包装器保留原始 cause。请按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message` 文本。

Web Streams byte I/O 的 close 在回调前发布同一个完成 Promise；回调抛错仍通知其它观察者并执行 reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭。失败统一以原生 AggregateError/PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED 拒绝，首错在 cause、全部原错在 errors，重复 close 加入同一结果。构造时 writer 获取失败会释放已取得的 reader 锁，调用方仍持有自己的原 writer；原生获取失败保留 TypeError 并附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。socket listener 重复 close 同样返回缓存的同一 Promise。
对端业务错误会被还原为原生类型：子进程抛出 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`，`message` 与 `stack` 保留；它没有 RPC 的 source / code（显示为 `unknown` / `UNKNOWN`）。
source 均为 `@migaia/rpc/process`。

超时、取消、断线和"结果未知"都不能证明对端没有执行。非幂等操作在重试前必须先确认结果：给调用加 `idempotencyKey`，失败后用 `outcome(key)` 查询；拿不到确定结果时，按业务规则对账。只有在对端确定没有执行时（例如 `OVERLOADED`、`PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT`，或 `cancel: 'before-start'` 成功撤销），才可以直接重试。

blocks.text: 消息通道的能力协商：消息通道上的固定基础能力（abort、ping、close、deadline、幂等、trace、stream、batch）无需额外握手。扩展能力（runtime 调用、二进制等）需要对端发回能力确认（ACK）：没有 ACK 或超时时只启用基础能力，实际启用的能力反映在 `agreement.capabilities` 中。

sections.heading: 10. 高阶用法：自己提供字节通道

blocks.text: 如果你有一条现成的有序字节连接（例如自定义的 IPC 或 socket），可以直接用 `createProcessTransport` 完成握手，得到协议通道，再交给 `@migaia/rpc-core` 的 Endpoint 或 Remote 组装：
适配器作者可用的其它构造函数：

rows: 把 Node `Duplex` 包装成字节通道
把子进程的 stdio 管道包装成字节通道
子进程一侧：包装自己的 stdin / stdout
把 Web Streams 包装成字节通道
为自定义运行时组装 launch、Peer 与 Plugin

blocks.text: 新适配器使用 `@migaia/rpc-core/adapter` 的 `defineByteAdapter` 或 `defineMessageAdapter`，让 Core 从真实 I/O 组装 Peer 与 Plugin；完整示例见 Core 的“编写一个适配器”。上表的原生资源构造继续适用于自定义运行时，复杂 launch、session 与诊断组合使用 `@migaia/rpc-core/adapter/internal-advanced`。这些操作只读取实际持有的资源，不接受“已认证 / 已协商”的声明。
直接运行子进程文件时报配置错误？ 自动来源只在库 launcher 启动的进程中成立。独立运行的服务请用 `listen`（第 5 节）。
父进程退出后子进程还在？ `close()` 或 `host.dispose()` 会停止 spawn 来源的子进程。父进程被强杀时来不及清理；子进程会检测到父连接丢失并退出。孙进程在 Node 上不保证被终止。
能跨机器调用吗？ 不能。socket 适配器只接受回环地址、Unix socket 和命名管道。
`notify` 成功了，为什么对端没有执行？ `notify` 只保证消息已发出。需要确认业务结果时用 `request`。
怎样传大文件？ 单条消息受帧上限约束。用 `stream` 分块传输，或者把文件路径传过去，由对端自己读取。

sections.heading: JSON-RPC 字节通道与对端协议

blocks.text: 普通子进程优先使用 `createProcessPeer` 的 JSON-RPC spawn。下列高级入口保留实际字节通道及其 stderr/诊断归属，不负责替调用方终止借用的进程。

blocks.code: import { createProcessJsonRpcChannel } from '@migaia/rpc-process'

blocks.text: `createProcessJsonRpcChannel(options)` 在一条有序字节连接上完成 `migaia.hello` 握手，返回协议通道。它用于自有字节通道的高级组合。普通 Python 子进程直接使用 README 的 `createProcessPeer({ spawn: { command, args, wire: 'jsonrpc', contract } })`，不必手写 launcher 或握手。

rows: 有序字节连接（`IProcessByteChannel`），来自 `@migaia/rpc-process` 的 launcher handle 或 socket 适配器。
`{ kind: 'plugin', contract }`（单个服务）或 `{ kind: 'host', catalog }`（对端是一个插件宿主）。见下文。
本端提议：`versions`、`peer: { id, runtime }`、`capabilities`。`codecs` 与 `auth` 由本包填写。
只能从 `deadline@1`、`trace@1`、`idempotency@1`（以及桥接必需能力）中选择；其它能力以 `JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID` 拒绝。
会话凭据，随 `migaia.hello` 发给对端认证。
计时依赖，通常用 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler` 与 `systemWallClock`。
`{ connectionId, sessionId, log }`：诊断标签与日志回调。
可选，握手超时；超时以 `JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT` 失败。

blocks.text: 关于 `target.contract`：它是本地声明，桥接只用它在建立连接前校验"没有 stream 方法"。真正可以调用的方法以对端 `migaia.describe` 返回的目录为准；调用目录之外的方法会以 `PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND` 拒绝。
必需能力 `jsonrpc-bridge@1`、`runtime-api@1`、`batch@1`、`abort@1`、`wire-error@1` 由本包自动加入提议，不需要在 `offer.capabilities` 中列出。

sections.id: json-rpc-2-获得字节通道-子进程与本机-socket
sections.heading: JSON-RPC 2. 获得字节通道：子进程与本机 socket

blocks.text: 子进程：用 `@migaia/rpc-process` 的 launcher 启动对端，取 `handle.channel`。`spec.stdio` 设为 `{ stdin: 'channel', stdout: 'channel', stderr: 'drain' }`，对端从 stdin 读、向 stdout 写；stderr 由库持续读取，对端可以放心向 stderr 写日志。用 `bootstrap: { via: 'stdin', payload }` 把 token 交给对端，对端会先读到一个"4 字节大端长度 + 内容"的 bootstrap 帧（见第 5.1 节）。
本机 socket：对端已经在监听时，用 `@migaia/rpc-process/adapters/node-socket` 的 `dialProcessByteChannel({ address })` 拨号，把返回的通道作为 `byte`。token 需要通过你自己的方式（例如配置或密钥服务）让双方事先共享。
所有权：`connect` 来源只拥有这条连接。`peer.close()` 关闭连接，但不会结束对端进程；如果进程是你启动的，用 `handle.terminate()` 结束它。

rows: 对端按数组顺序处理，并以数组回复（notify 不出现在回复中）
通知对端放弃该调用；不等待确认，不回滚已发生的副作用

items: payload 必须是数组，作为对端方法的位置参数列表；传入非数组以 `JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID` 拒绝。
数据经 JSON 编码。跨语言传整数时，超过 ±(2^53 − 1) 的值请用字符串表示。
帧、UTF-8 或 JSON 格式非法时连接会被终止（`JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID`）。
收到未知 `id` 或迟到的回复会被报告并丢弃，不影响其它调用。

blocks.text: 下面的实现只依赖 Python 标准库，与 README 的 TypeScript parent 构成同一个可执行文档组，覆盖 `request`、`notify`、并发批量调用和业务错误。把它保存为 `service.py`，即可作为其它语言实现的参照。
实现要点：

items: 先读 bootstrap 帧拿到 token，再进入 Content-Length 消息循环。
握手通过前，除 `migaia.hello` 外的任何消息都应拒绝（示例直接退出）。
握手回复中的 `capabilities` 必须包含五个必需能力，`methods` 必须列出全部四个扩展方法，否则 TypeScript 端以 `JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING` 拒绝。
回复写到 stdout，日志写到 stderr，不要把日志混进 stdout。

sections.id: json-rpc-5-高阶用法-对端协议规范-5-1-分帧
sections.heading: JSON-RPC 5. 高阶用法：对端协议规范 · 5.1 分帧

items: bootstrap 帧（仅子进程场景、启用 `bootstrap` 时）：连接建立后，对端最先从 stdin 收到一个 4 字节大端无符号长度，紧接着是该长度的 UTF-8 内容（通常是 token）。之后才是 JSON-RPC 消息。
消息帧：`Content-Length: <字节数>\r\n\r\n<UTF-8 JSON>`。长度按 UTF-8 字节计算，不是字符数。头部不超过 1024 字节，单帧不超过 16 MiB。
消息体是一个 JSON-RPC 2.0 对象，或者（握手成功后）一个由这些对象组成的数组（批量）。

sections.id: json-rpc-5-高阶用法-对端协议规范-5-6-错误格式
sections.heading: JSON-RPC 5. 高阶用法：对端协议规范 · 5.6 错误格式

blocks.text: 业务失败时，按 JSON-RPC 规范回复 `error`，并把完整错误信息放在 `data.migaiaWireError`：

wire error 至少包含 `source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`；可选的 `cause` 与 `errors` 用于嵌套原因。JSON-RPC 整数 `code` 建议使用标准值：`-32700`（解析错误）、`-32600`（无效请求）、`-32601`（方法不存在）、`-32602`（参数无效）、`-32603`（内部错误）、`-32000`（业务错误）。

TypeScript 实现的对端可以直接用 `@migaia/rpc-contract/errors` 的 `toJsonRpcError(serialized, code)` 与 `fromJsonRpcError(value)` 生成和解析这种格式，并用 `@migaia/rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc` 的 `encodeJsonRpcFrame`、`createJsonRpcFrameDecoder` 处理 Content-Length 分帧。

sections.id: json-rpc-5-高阶用法-对端协议规范-5-7-批量
sections.heading: JSON-RPC 5. 高阶用法：对端协议规范 · 5.7 批量

blocks.text: 握手成功后，TypeScript 端可能把多个调用放进一个数组发送。对端应按数组顺序逐个处理，并把所有带 `id` 的回复按顺序放进一个数组写回；某个成员失败不影响其它成员。全是 notify 的批量不需要回复。
source 均为 `@migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc`。

rows: 头部、UTF-8、JSON 非法，或连接在一帧中途关闭；连接随之终止
修正对端的分帧与编码；已发出的调用先对账
握手回复缺少必需能力或四个扩展方法
本端选项不合法，或提议了桥接不支持的能力
修正选项；原样重试无效
本地声明或对端目录中包含 stream 方法
流式场景改用原生协议
检查对端是否在读 stdin / socket，然后重新建立连接

blocks.text: 这些 JSON-RPC 常量从 Contract 的 framing 入口导入：

通过 `createProcessPeer` 或 `createRuntimePeer` 调用时，对端回复的 wire error 按原始 `name`、`source`、`code`、`message`、`stack` 和原因链恢复。Python 示例中的业务错误因此携带 `source: 'python-service'`、`code: 'BUSINESS'`。这些字段只用于诊断，不会获得本地库的控制身份；不要用对端声明的 source / code 判断本地取消、重试或认证策略。
超时、取消或连接中断都不能证明对端没有执行。对非幂等方法，重试前请先确认结果，或者让对端在 `meta.idempotencyKey` 上实现去重。
握手一直超时？ 确认对端在读 stdin（或 socket），并且回复写到了 stdout 而不是 stderr；确认先消费了 bootstrap 帧。
对端日志打乱了协议？ stdout 只能输出协议帧，日志写 stderr。
需要流式返回？ 桥接不支持。可以拆成分页的 `request`，或者把对端改为原生协议实现。
对端能主动调用 TypeScript 端吗？ 桥接协议在同一连接上允许对端发送 `migaia.invoke`，调用 TypeScript 端 `provide` 的方法。本手册的示例只演示 TypeScript 端发起调用；需要反向调用时，请先在你的场景中验证。

symbols.purpose: Advanced: `createProcessPeer` with a custom runtime I/O loader for unsupported runtimes.
symbols.core:
options: Peer options; see `IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions`.
runtime: Loader whose `load()` returns `{ processRuntimeIO }`.
forwarded: Short-source options (`token`, `verify`, `connectTimeoutMs`) forwarded from a plugin.
An `IRuntimeTypedPeer`.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
`console.error`.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
spawn: Child to start and own: `URL`, path (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (current entry), a short object `{ entry | command, args?, wrap?, wire?, ... }`, or a full `ISpawnProcessPluginDeployment`.
Not set.
connect: Running service to dial: a name (`math-service`), `tcp://127.0.0.1:port`, a Unix path, or a full connect deployment.
listen: Address or name to accept sessions on; each session is its own connection.
token: Shared secret checked in the handshake; required for TCP, explicit socket paths and Windows pipes. Generate it per deployment and never log it.
Not set: named endpoints rely on OS user permissions.
verify: Listener side: `(auth, peer) => principalId` validating the client credential; throw to reject.
verify.auth: Portable credential from the incoming handshake, possibly undefined.
verify.peer: Handshake peer metadata supplied by the accepted transport.
Verified principal string or its Promise; throw or rejection refuses the candidate.
Not set: the `token` comparison is used.
connectTimeoutMs: How long a named `connect` waits for the listener to appear.
`5000`.

forwarded: IProcessShortSourceOptions (optional)

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Either complete IProcessPluginOptions with deployment, or symmetric IRuntimeProcessPluginOptions with spawn/connect/listen and provide/expose.
runtime: Loader whose `load()` returns `{ processRuntimeIO }`.
Full deployment returns IProcessPlugin, including its deployment controls; symmetric source returns the Core runtime plugin for the process slot and does not promise replace.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing host.process.
contract: Application remote contract. Required and matched to name for a full deployment; optional for runtime sources, where provide normally supplies the directory.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
registrationOwner: Identifies the plugin registration that may be removed if its process cannot recover. In the full deployment form, supply the exact registration name and the Host that installs it. When failure reports remain unhandled, cleanup uses this Host to remove that registration. The name must equal options.name and the Host must provide unUse; missing or mismatched values reject configuration before process setup.
resilience: Caller-owned governance from createProcessResilience, borrowed by this plugin rather than closed with it.
Omitted: create and own a governor using the deployment scheduler and report callback.
host: Full deployment: Host port owning installation and replacement. Runtime form: the actual installing Host, needed only when exposing host control with catalog and resolvePlugin.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
endpointFactory: Endpoint factory called with the acquired channel and abort signal; mandatory for full deployments, while runtime sources can use canonical endpoint assembly.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
`console.error`.
keyFactory: Full deployment proxy key callback for automatically keyed idempotent calls. Runtime form forwards this inherited field; direct Peer assembly does not read it.
Application-issued string key for that call.
Omitted: the proxy uses defaultRpcId.
retryPort: Advanced full-deployment remote-proxy retry port. Runtime form forwards the inherited field, while direct Peer assembly keeps its own call path.
Omitted: createRemoteRetryPort uses the binding events, scheduler and reporter.
deployment: Spawn or connect deployment.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
spawn: Child to start and own: `URL`, path (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (current entry), a short object `{ entry | command, args?, wrap?, wire?, ... }`, or a full `ISpawnProcessPluginDeployment`.
Not set.
connect: Running service to dial: a name (`math-service`), `tcp://127.0.0.1:port`, a Unix path, or a full connect deployment.
listen: Address or name to accept sessions on; each session is its own connection.
token: Shared secret checked in the handshake; required for TCP, explicit socket paths and Windows pipes. Generate it per deployment and never log it.
Not set: named endpoints rely on OS user permissions.
verify: Listener side: `(auth, peer) => principalId` validating the client credential; throw to reject.
verify.auth: Portable credential from the incoming handshake, possibly undefined.
verify.peer: Handshake peer metadata supplied by the accepted transport.
Verified principal string or its Promise; throw or rejection refuses the candidate.
Not set: the `token` comparison is used.
connectTimeoutMs: How long a named `connect` waits for the listener to appear.
`5000`.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.
registrationOwner.name: Names the one registration that failure cleanup may remove. Set it to the value of options.name for this plugin before constructing the full deployment. A different name rejects configuration, preventing failure handling for this plugin from removing another registration.
registrationOwner.host: Supplies the Host that actually installs this plugin. Failure cleanup invokes its unUse method to remove the named registration and apply the Host rules for dependent plugins. Pass that original Host; an object without unUse is rejected before process setup. The caller continues to own the Host.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: `IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions`: `byte`, `peerId`, `target`, `offer`, `token`, `scheduler`, `wallClock`, `ipc`, `handshakeTimeoutMs?`, `signal?`, `report`.
A channel; `stream` and `transfer` are not supported over JSON-RPC.
peerId: Caller-selected remote routing identity, usually from the launched process or received bootstrap; a negotiated runtime identity may supersede it.
signal: Caller-owned IAbortSignal cancelling this handshake attempt; later connection ownership remains with the returned channel.
Omitted: no external abort listener is attached.
handshakeTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative millisecond budget for the initial JSON-RPC bridge handshake; it does not bound later method calls.
10000 ms from JsonRpcLimit.handshakeMs.
scheduler: Required caller-selected IScheduler for handshake deadline and established connection tasks; no clock is inferred by this bridge.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
ipc: Caller-authored connection and session labels plus the logging port; stderr and queue limits are optional.
byte: Caller-owned ordered IProcessByteChannel returned by a launcher, socket adapter or stdio wrapper, with kind byte.
target: Explicit plugin contract or host catalog target: plugin requires contract only, while host requires catalog only. Stream declarations are rejected.
offer: Caller-authored native offer without auth or codecs. The bridge inserts the token, JSON codec and required JSON-RPC capabilities.
token: Nonempty credential issued by the deployment owner and expected by the JSON-RPC peer; copied into the bridge handshake, never diagnostic output.
wallClock: Required caller-selected IWallClock supplying timestamp() for outgoing JSON-RPC message sentAt metadata, distinct from monotonic scheduling.
ipc.connectionId: Caller-issued non-secret identifier for this physical connection, copied into diagnostic records.
ipc.sessionId: Caller-issued identifier for this logical session, allowing records from one session to be correlated.
ipc.processId: Optional process label issued by the caller for diagnostic correlation; it grants no authentication authority.
Omitted: records have no process label.
ipc.maxPendingData: Maximum queued data frames in the canonical Core send queue; separate control capacity remains available.
256 pending data frames.
ipc.maxPendingControl: Maximum queued control frames in the canonical Core send queue, independent of data-frame capacity.
8 pending control frames.
ipc.log: Callback receiving each Core IIpcLogRecord; synchronous throws and Promise rejections enter the original reporter boundary.
ipc.log.record: Structured, connection-labelled IPC record supplied by Core.
Void or Promise<void>; asynchronous completion is observed by the logging owner.
ipc.stderr: Subscription callback for child stderr bytes. The diagnostic bridge records bounded redacted summaries rather than the raw text.
ipc.stderr.listener: Bridge callback receiving each Uint8Array chunk from the child.
Unsubscribe function owned and invoked by the connection cleanup.
Omitted: no child-stderr subscription is attached.
target.kind: Required discriminant selecting the one target contract grammar.
Use target.contract for a single declared plugin.
Use target.catalog for the declared Host plugin set.

symbols.signature: export declare function createProcessPeer<TRemote = Record<never, never>>(options: IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions): Promise<IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote, IRuntimeFlatten<TRemote>, typeof RuntimePluginKey.process>>;
symbols.purpose: Opens a Runtime Peer to another process. Choose exactly one source: `spawn` (start and own a child), `connect` (dial a running service) or `listen` (accept sessions). A child started by the library may omit the source to connect back. Resolves after the authenticated handshake.
symbols.core:
options: See `IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions`: the source, `provide`, `report` (default `console.error`), `token`, `verify`, `connectTimeoutMs`, `defaultTimeoutMs` (default 30000) and the Core Peer options.
An `IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote>`. `close()` stops accepting calls, lets accepted calls finish, closes the connection, and also stops a spawned child.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
`console.error`.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
spawn: Child to start and own: `URL`, path (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (current entry), a short object `{ entry | command, args?, wrap?, wire?, ... }`, or a full `ISpawnProcessPluginDeployment`.
Not set.
connect: Running service to dial: a name (`math-service`), `tcp://127.0.0.1:port`, a Unix path, or a full connect deployment.
listen: Address or name to accept sessions on; each session is its own connection.
token: Shared secret checked in the handshake; required for TCP, explicit socket paths and Windows pipes. Generate it per deployment and never log it.
Not set: named endpoints rely on OS user permissions.
verify: Listener side: `(auth, peer) => principalId` validating the client credential; throw to reject.
verify.auth: Portable credential from the incoming handshake, possibly undefined.
verify.peer: Handshake peer metadata supplied by the accepted transport.
Verified principal string or its Promise; throw or rejection refuses the candidate.
Not set: the `token` comparison is used.
connectTimeoutMs: How long a named `connect` waits for the listener to appear.
`5000`.

Isolate CPU-heavy or crash-prone work in a child process.
Let a CLI call a resident daemon on the same machine by name.
Call a Python or Go process that speaks JSON-RPC (`spawn.wire: "jsonrpc"`).
Threads in the same process: use `@migaia/rpc-threads` (zero-copy transfer).
Other machines: sockets only accept local addresses.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Isolate CPU-heavy or crash-prone work in a child process.
Let a CLI call a resident daemon on the same machine by name.
Call a Python or Go process that speaks JSON-RPC (`spawn.wire: "jsonrpc"`).
Threads in the same process: use `@migaia/rpc-threads` (zero-copy transfer).
Other machines: sockets only accept local addresses.

Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.

report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.

deployment: Spawn or connect deployment.

provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.

verify: Listener side: `(auth, peer) => principalId` validating the client credential; throw to reject.

Verified principal string or its Promise; throw or rejection refuses the candidate.
Not set: the `token` comparison is used.
connectTimeoutMs: How long a named `connect` waits for the listener to appear.
`5000`.

catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.

Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a plugin that installs one process connection into a PluginHost; the host owns it and gains `host.process`. The advanced overload takes a full `IProcessPluginOptions` remote-plugin deployment.

symbols.signature: export declare function createProcessResilience(options: IProcessResilienceOptions): IProcessResilience;
symbols.purpose: Creates the governance owner for process connections: connection, call-rate and payload limits, idle and timeout handling, terminal diagnostics and liquidation. Pass it as `resilience` to plugins or listeners.
symbols.core:
options: `IProcessResilienceOptions`: `scheduler`, `report` and optional limits.
An `IProcessResilience`; bad limits throw `PROCESS_RESILIENCE_INVALID_OPTION`.
scheduler: Clock for rate windows, idle and drain timers.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
idempotencyStore: Store of results for `idempotencyKey` calls.
An in-memory store.
maxConnections: Connections accepted at once.
`64`.
maxConcurrentCallsPerConnection: Calls running at once per connection.
`32`.
maxCallsPerMinute: Calls per connection per minute.
`600`.
maxPayloadBytes: Largest payload accepted.
16 MiB.
maxConsecutiveTimeouts: Timeouts in a row that close the connection.
`3`.
idleTimeoutMs: Idle time after which a session closes.
`60000`.
drainMs: Time accepted calls get to finish when closing.
`5000`.
reportAtMs: When to report a terminal registration again (relative times).
`[0, 60000, 300000, 900000]`.
unhandledLimit: Unhandled terminal reports before liquidation starts.
liquidation: `{ cascade }`: also remove plugins depending on the liquidated one.
`cascade: false`: dependants are suspended.
liquidation.cascade: Whether terminal liquidation also removes dependent registrations through the existing Host dependency owner.
False: dependants are suspended instead of cascade removal.
Remove dependants together with the terminal registration.

drainMs: Time accepted calls get to finish when closing.

blocks.text: Process carrier 观察尚未实现：`createProcessTransport(...).transport.observe` 当前不存在。计划中的字节事件包含 `detail.frameBytes`（含 4 字节长度前缀的完整物理帧字节数）与 `detail.drainMs`（物理写入发生回压后等待 drain 的毫秒数），内容捕获仅在 `probe.capturing` 为 true 时启用，并保留原字节引用。Node/Bun/Deno stdio 与 socket 的帧编码、解码和 transport 由 Core 的统一字节通道持有；当前接口未暴露帧观察与真实回压等待。Electron utility process 实际使用 whole-message 通道，仍需确定其 detail 语义。完成这些接口前，不应将逻辑 send 耗时当作 `drainMs`，也不能声称 Process carrier 已支持观察。
本包登记的通道、启动与监听错误带 `(source, code)`，按这两个字段判断，不要依赖 `message` 文本。同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断保留原生对象、类型及 stack，并把原生 errno code 归入本包语义码；操作系统其它字段仍保留：

items: 本包错误：`source === '@migaia/rpc/process'`，`code` 取自 `RpcProcessErrorCode`，例如 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`、`PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`。
调用层错误来自 `@migaia/rpc/core`，例如超时 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`（`TimeoutError`）、取消 `CANCELLED`（`AbortError`）、过载 `OVERLOADED`。
对端业务函数抛出的错误会还原原生类型、`message` 和 `stack`，例如子进程抛 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`。

symbols.purpose: Result of `peer.describe()`: this side identity, its methods and its connections.
symbols.core:
methods: Method paths provided by this local Peer; each connection detail separately lists its accepted remote methods.
counters: Call counters: `inFlight` (calls not yet finished) is measured; `sent`, `received`, `errors`, `lastActiveAt` are reported unavailable; or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
recent: Recent lifecycle records (`IRuntimeRecent`), newest last.
identity: Identity `{ name, instanceId }` of this Peer.
self: Same identity, as given by the `self` option or generated.
provide: Method paths this side provides.
connections: Details of every connection (`IRuntimeConnectionDetail`).
unit: Unavailable for a local Peer; see `connections`.
health: A local Peer may have several connections, so this field does not combine them into one health result. It returns an unavailable value. Inspect each connection to see whether that connection is healthy.
restartCount: Restart counts describe individual connections, not the local Peer as a whole. This field returns an unavailable value. Inspect the relevant connection when you need its restart count.
resources: Resource measurements belong to the execution unit behind each connection. The local Peer returns an unavailable value here rather than a combined measurement. Inspect a connection for the resource information its runtime supports.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

blocks.text: 本包登记的通道、启动和监听错误使用原生 `Error`（或其子类）及 `source`、`code`。原生同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断在原对象上附包身份，原生 errno code 改为语义码，类型、其它字段和 stack 保持；已有包装器保留原始 cause。请按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message` 文本。

Web Streams byte I/O 的 close 在回调前发布同一个完成 Promise；回调抛错仍通知其它观察者并执行 reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭。失败统一以原生 AggregateError/PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED 拒绝，首错在 cause、全部原错在 errors，重复 close 加入同一结果。构造时 writer 获取失败会释放已取得的 reader 锁，调用方仍持有自己的原 writer；原生获取失败保留 TypeError 并附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。socket listener 重复 close 同样返回缓存的同一 Promise。
对端业务错误会被还原为原生类型：子进程抛出 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`，`message` 与 `stack` 保留；它没有 RPC 的 source / code（显示为 `unknown` / `UNKNOWN`）。

blocks.text: 本包登记的通道、启动和监听错误使用原生 `Error`（或其子类）及 `source`、`code`。原生同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断在原对象上附包身份，原生 errno code 改为语义码，类型、其它字段和 stack 保持；已有包装器保留原始 cause。请按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message` 文本。

Web Streams byte I/O 的 close 在回调前发布同一个完成 Promise；回调抛错仍通知其它观察者并执行 reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭。失败统一以原生 AggregateError/PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED 拒绝，首错在 cause、全部原错在 errors，重复 close 加入同一结果。构造时 writer 获取失败会释放已取得的 reader 锁，调用方仍持有自己的原 writer；原生获取失败保留 TypeError 并附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。socket listener 重复 close 同样返回缓存的同一 Promise。
对端业务错误会被还原为原生类型：子进程抛出 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`，`message` 与 `stack` 保留；它没有 RPC 的 source / code（显示为 `unknown` / `UNKNOWN`）。

symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
usageSampleFailed: `PROCESS_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED`: CPU or memory sampling failed; show unavailable.
hostInvalidOption: `PROCESS_HOST_INVALID_OPTION`: a host option is invalid; fix the named field.
hostClosed: `PROCESS_HOST_CLOSED`: the outlet is releasing; use a new host or Peer.
handshakeTimeout: `PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`: the handshake did not finish in time; open a new channel.
authRejected: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`: the credential was refused; do not retry with it.
channelClosed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`: work on a closed channel; reconnect and reconcile.
connectFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`: connecting to the other process, starting it, or setting up part of the channel failed. If the system call that starts the process or opens its streams throws, you get that same error object with its type, stack and fields intact. Its `source` becomes this package and its system `code` (such as `ENOENT`) becomes `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`, one stable value to check. An already wrapped failure keeps the original on `cause`.
listenFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED`: preparing to listen, or binding the listening address, failed. You receive the same system error object, with its type, stack and other fields unchanged; it only gains this package as `source` and `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED` as `code`. Both the reported error and the rejected promise keep the original `cause` chain.
pluginInvalidOption: `PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION`: a plugin or source option is invalid.
resilienceInvalidOption: `PROCESS_RESILIENCE_INVALID_OPTION`: a governance limit is invalid.
connectionLimit: `PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT`: connection, rate or payload limit; the call did not run.
instanceUnhealthy: `PROCESS_INSTANCE_UNHEALTHY`: the target is suspended until a healthy replacement is ready.
healthPingFailed: `PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED`: a health ping failed; supervision restarts it.
terminalCall: `PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL`: the registration is terminal and refuses calls.
liquidated: `PROCESS_LIQUIDATED`: the registration was liquidated; create a new one.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
usageSampleFailed: `PROCESS_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED`: CPU or memory sampling failed; show unavailable.
hostInvalidOption: `PROCESS_HOST_INVALID_OPTION`: a host option is invalid; fix the named field.
hostClosed: `PROCESS_HOST_CLOSED`: the outlet is releasing; use a new host or Peer.
handshakeTimeout: `PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`: the handshake did not finish in time; open a new channel.
authRejected: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`: the credential was refused; do not retry with it.
channelClosed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`: work on a closed channel; reconnect and reconcile.
connectFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`: connecting to the other process, starting it, or setting up part of the channel failed. If the system call that starts the process or opens its streams throws, you get that same error object with its type, stack and fields intact. Its `source` becomes this package and its system `code` (such as `ENOENT`) becomes `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`, one stable value to check. An already wrapped failure keeps the original on `cause`.
listenFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED`: preparing to listen, or binding the listening address, failed. You receive the same system error object, with its type, stack and other fields unchanged; it only gains this package as `source` and `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED` as `code`. Both the reported error and the rejected promise keep the original `cause` chain.
pluginInvalidOption: `PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION`: a plugin or source option is invalid.
resilienceInvalidOption: `PROCESS_RESILIENCE_INVALID_OPTION`: a governance limit is invalid.
connectionLimit: `PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT`: connection, rate or payload limit; the call did not run.
instanceUnhealthy: `PROCESS_INSTANCE_UNHEALTHY`: the target is suspended until a healthy replacement is ready.
healthPingFailed: `PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED`: a health ping failed; supervision restarts it.
terminalCall: `PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL`: the registration is terminal and refuses calls.
liquidated: `PROCESS_LIQUIDATED`: the registration was liquidated; create a new one.

blocks.text: 本包登记的通道、启动和监听错误使用原生 `Error`（或其子类）及 `source`、`code`。原生同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断在原对象上附包身份，原生 errno code 改为语义码，类型、其它字段和 stack 保持；已有包装器保留原始 cause。请按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message` 文本。

Web Streams byte I/O 的 close 在回调前发布同一个完成 Promise；回调抛错仍通知其它观察者并执行 reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭。失败统一以原生 AggregateError/PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED 拒绝，首错在 cause、全部原错在 errors，重复 close 加入同一结果。构造时 writer 获取失败会释放已取得的 reader 锁，调用方仍持有自己的原 writer；原生获取失败保留 TypeError 并附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。socket listener 重复 close 同样返回缓存的同一 Promise。
对端业务错误会被还原为原生类型：子进程抛出 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`，`message` 与 `stack` 保留；它没有 RPC 的 source / code（显示为 `unknown` / `UNKNOWN`）。

Process carrier 观察尚未实现：`createProcessTransport(...).transport.observe` 当前不存在。计划中的字节事件包含 `detail.frameBytes`（含 4 字节长度前缀的完整物理帧字节数）与 `detail.drainMs`（物理写入发生回压后等待 drain 的毫秒数），内容捕获仅在 `probe.capturing` 为 true 时启用，并保留原字节引用。Node/Bun/Deno stdio 与 socket 的帧编码、解码和 transport 由 Core 的统一字节通道持有；当前接口未暴露帧观察与真实回压等待。Electron utility process 实际使用 whole-message 通道，仍需确定其 detail 语义。完成这些接口前，不应将逻辑 send 耗时当作 `drainMs`，也不能声称 Process carrier 已支持观察。
本包登记的通道、启动与监听错误带 `(source, code)`，按这两个字段判断，不要依赖 `message` 文本。同步 spawn、Unix listener 准备和 bind 诊断保留原生对象、类型及 stack，并把原生 errno code 归入本包语义码；操作系统其它字段仍保留：

items: 本包错误：`source === '@migaia/rpc/process'`，`code` 取自 `RpcProcessErrorCode`，例如 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`、`PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`。
调用层错误来自 `@migaia/rpc/core`，例如超时 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`（`TimeoutError`）、取消 `CANCELLED`（`AbortError`）、过载 `OVERLOADED`。
对端业务函数抛出的错误会还原原生类型、`message` 和 `stack`，例如子进程抛 `RangeError('bad input')`，父端收到的也是 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 超时、断线或"结果未知"都不代表对端没有执行。重试非幂等操作前请先对账，详见 USEGUIDE 第 8 节。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: `{ bootstrap: "stdin" | "none", bootstrapTimeoutMs? }`: select bootstrap reading; fd mode is unsupported and omitted timeout installs no timer.
`{ channel, bootstrap? }`.
bootstrap: Required bootstrap source policy for this public child stdio opener. Both Node and Deno implement stdin or none and explicitly reject fd.
Consume the parent-written bootstrap frame before passing the channel to handshake.
Skip bootstrap decoding and return the raw stdio channel.
Declared in the input union but rejected by these implementations with Core INVALID_CONFIG.
fd: Declared file-descriptor field; these public openers do not read it because fd bootstrap mode is rejected.
Omitted: no file descriptor is selected or read.
bootstrapTimeoutMs: Caller-selected finite nonnegative milliseconds to wait for the initial bootstrap frame; this does not bound later handshake or business calls.
Omitted: this public reader installs no bootstrap timeout timer.
